title: Great sites to see
text: Lola was fantastic. She knew the history. Learned a lot. Had time to wander the grounds. Lucked out with almost one on one excursion! Ask for Lola!

title: Perfect amount of time to...

author: Christina_N

title: We were so happy with...
text: We were so happy with this tour!  There was so much to see and our tour guide was able to share so much information with us.  We were also pleased with the small group experience!  Highly recommended!
author: Gina_L

title: Absolutely stunning!  Must do this tour!
text: We really enjoyed and recommend this tour of the Giralda, Cathedral, & Alcázar. No waiting to get in. Our tour guide, Ferren, was extremely knowledgeable about the history and architecture. We moved at a good pace, never feeling rushed. There is so much to see & it is quite stunning…all of it!!! We climbed to the top of the giralda & had time to take in the 360 views and take pictures. Quite stunning! The Alcázar & Cathedral are both stunning & should not be missed. Loved that this tour included all 3 sights together. Thank you Ferren for making it so meaningful!!!
author: Janel_S

title: Worth doing
text: Great tour. Guide was very knowledgeable and balanced historical details with good humour and paced the different venues very well, inlding personal time for own exploration.

text: Ferran was excellent- humorous and informative and very accommodating when we needed to leave a bit early. Alkazar is amazing.
author: W2383AYsteves

title: Andres was the perfect...
text: Andres was the perfect guide and shared just enough knowledge without boring you with too much information.  He kept the tour moving at a good pace and showed you all the highlights so that you felt like you did not miss anything.  He was very friendly and made the tour an enjoyable experience.  I would skip walking to the top of the Giralda tower as it is very crowded at the top and the views are all fenced in and not as good as expected.
author: Tim_R
